Exhibit 99.1

Termination of Previously Announced Initial Public Offering

On October 30, 2026, OPay Limited (the “Company”) (NYSE: OPAY) decided not to complete its previously announced initial public offering (the “Offering”). The decision was made following a recent regulatory inquiry relating to a jurisdiction immaterial to the Company’s business operations. The Company is confident that the inquiry will be concluded satisfactorily in the near future, however, after careful consideration and discussions with the underwriters, the Company determined that not proceeding with the Offering at this time would be the most prudent course of action. As such, the Company and the underwriters mutually agreed to terminate the underwriting agreement dated October 29, 2026, relating to the Offering.

As a result, the Offering will not be completed, and the Company’s ADSs will not commence trading on the New York Stock Exchange as previously scheduled.
